steps.title: Gather required consumables and equipment
steps.instruction: Collect a MicroAmp Optical 384‑well plate, a USA Scientific 96‑well plate (100 µL capacity), a 25 mL single‑channel reservoir (spanning slots 4 and 1), an Opentrons P10 multi‑channel GEN1 pipette, and an Opentrons 10 µL tiprack.

steps.title: Configure pipette parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, set the mount side for the P10 multi‑channel GEN1 pipette and specify the number of DNA samples to process (choose a value between 1 and 96; samples are processed in columns of 8).

steps.title: Download protocol package
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package provided for the CNV plating assay.

steps.title: Upload custom labware and script
steps.instruction: Upload the custom labware definition and the protocol script into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the labware on the deck following the supplied deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tiprack, and pipette using the OT App; refer to the calibration support articles if needed.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the protocol.
